reviewed_by: Codex review of October 13 Code editor release failure and state synchronization
reason: The Code editor must preserve every keystroke and caret position while React echoes earlier buffer values, then accept a deliberate workspace reload. A real CodeMirror component regression covers delayed echoes and external replacement; six focused desktop and phone browser cases cover the visible editor journey; one production LAN real-Core case checks exact saved bytes and reopening. The editor view owns immediate unsaved input, React owns the recoverable draft, and Core owns saved workspace bytes.
exclusions: Python and native tests, unrelated Workbench/VPN failures, other browser areas, and the full suite are excluded. Desktop and 320-430 px phone profiles are emulated; no physical device is available. The selected real-Core case uses the production bundle on a non-loopback LAN origin.
